rules.remediation: Validate and sanitize all user-supplied inputs. Use parameterized queries / prepared statements exclusively. Enforce least-privilege service accounts on the database.
Ensure all user inputs are contextually HTML-escaped before display in the browser. Implement a strong Content Security Policy (CSP) and set HttpOnly flags on session cookies.
Disable Telnet daemon service. Implement SSH for secure, encrypted remote shell access instead.
Decommission plain-text FTP services. Replace with SFTP (SSH File Transfer Protocol) or HTTPS secure transfers.
Restrict SSH ingress ports to known management subnet IPs. Disable password authentication in favor of public key login and disable root ssh logins.
Apply current stable package updates for the BIND9 service daemon. Restrict recursive queries to authorized local addresses only.
Ensure the Apache webserver banner details are hidden (ServerTokens ProductOnly, ServerSignature Off) and configure proper TLS.
Disable deprecated TLS versions (1.0 and 1.1). Enforce TLS 1.2 or 1.3 and select secure ciphers (ECDHE/AES-GCM).
